title: The build a Worker runs (T-413)
description: GET https://crow.direct/version.json (crow-site), https://crow.direct/agents/test-seller/version.json and https://crow.direct/agents/test-buyer/version.json (crow-test-agents), https://join.crow.direct/version.json (crow-early-access). commit: the commit the Worker was built from, filled by its deploy. deployedAt and versionId: from Cloudflare's version-metadata binding, the time the live version was created at its upload and its ID. null means unknown.
